models.name: Ensemble
models.description: Stacked meta-model: learns, from earlier seasons only, how much to trust the betting market and each model below.

models.name: Market
models.description: The betting favorite from the closing spread (home team on a pick'em). The bar every model has to clear.

models.name: Elo
models.description: FiveThirtyEight-style Elo with margin of victory, home field, rest, travel and a starting-QB adjustment.

models.name: Kalman ratings
models.description: Team strength tracked week to week by a Kalman filter on point margins and EPA, with off-season regression.

models.name: Power ratings
models.description: Opponent-adjusted (Massey/ridge) ratings on point margin and EPA per play, decayed toward recent games.

models.name: EPA logistic
models.description: Regularized logistic regression on ~50 opponent-adjusted play-by-play efficiency stats (no betting line).

models.name: Gradient boosting
models.description: LightGBM on the betting line plus the efficiency stats; a second booster predicts the result against the spread.

models.name: XGBoost margin
models.description: XGBoost regression of the final margin on efficiency stats (no betting line).

models.name: QB & injuries
models.description: The betting line adjusted by starting-QB value, QB changes and snap-weighted injury load by position group.

models.name: Lineup only
models.description: Who is playing, priced without the betting line: QB ratings, injuries, rest.

models.name: Situational
models.description: Market structure (moneyline vs spread, implied totals) plus rest, travel, body clock, revenge and other spots that held up out of sample.

models.name: Neural net
models.description: A small neural network (5 seeds averaged) predicting how far the result lands from what the market implies.

models.name: Similar games
models.description: The 300 most similar past games: how often the home side won and covered.
